fact: On 1 June 2021 first technical tests began at the national data centre in Abomey-Calavi, intended to host all of the State's information systems and to offer hosting capacity to semi-public and private bodies, with ANSI/TIA 942 level 3 certification under way.
title: Datacenter national : démarrage des premiers tests techniques sous le regard de la Ministre du Numérique et de la Digitalisation
publisher: Ministère de la Transformation Digitale et de l'Innovation (Bénin)
